ME HAB BIN IN DIS CITY {A YEAR|TWO WINTERS|LONG ENOUGH} AN' ME STILL GET LOST BY DA STATION!
TODAY ME LEARNED DA WORD 'QUEUE'. HUMANS LOVE IT DEARLY!
ME COULD USE A QUIET HOUR AMONG {PLANTS|BOOKS|OLD TREES}!

SOMEWHERE A NAGUKA IZ 'BOUT TA {TRIP|SHOUT|EAT SOMETINK UNWISE}. ME CAN FEEL IT COMIN'!

EVERYTINK HERE HAB A PLUG. EVERYTINK WANTS TA BE FED!

ME SHOULD WRITE TA ME COUSIN IN {OSLO|TURIN|LYON}. PAPER LETTERS IZ SUCH A GIFT!
DA LIBRARY SMELLS LIKE DA OLD ARCHIVE AT HOME. DUST AN' PATIENCE!
ME IZ TOLD A CAR CAN GO A HUNDRED KILOMETRES IN ONE HOUR. WHY WOULD ANYONE WISH TA?
HUMANS KEEP DEY PLANTS IN PLASTIC POTS AN' WONDER WHY DEY SULK!
ME REPOTTED DA {FERN|BASIL|LEMON TREE}. IT THANKED ME IN ITS OWN WAY!
{SLOW|STEADY|QUIET} WORK IZ STILL WORK. ME TELL ME DAT EVERY EVENIN'!
A MAN ASKED IF ME WAZ {FROM DA CIRCUS|AN ACTOR|COLD}. ME SAID ME WAZ FROM REAL FAR AWAY!
DA SKY HERE IZ A LIL' CROOKED SINCE 1992. ONE GETS USED TA IT!
ME WOULD LIKE A CUP OF SOMETINK WARM AN' A CHAIR BY A WINDOW!

ME ELDERS SAY MACHINES MAKE A PEOPLE FORGET HOW TA WAIT. ME WAIT FOR DA BUS EVERY DAY!
DERE IZ HONEY AT DA MARKET TODAY. {GOOD|PROPER|REAL} HONEY!
ME KEEP THINKIN' 'BOUT {DA FIELDS|HOME|DA OLD ORCHARDS}. OFTEN, AN' GENTLY!
A PHOTOCOPIER MADE TWO OF ME LETTER. ME WAZ NEARLY FRIGHTENED!
SOMEONE LEFT A NEWSPAPER ON DA BENCH. ME READ EVERY PAGE, EVEN DA ADVERTS!
DA SOIL IN DIS COURTYARD IZ TIRED. IT NEEDS {REST|CLOVER|A KIND HAND}!
ME DID A LIL' {WARMIN'|MENDIN'|CALMIN'} CHARM TODAY. NOBODY NOTICED. GOOD!
PEOPLE HERE SAY 'SEE YOU' AN' DEN DEY TRULY DO. IT IZ LOVELY!
EVERYONE IZ IN SUCH A HURRY TA ARRIVE. NOBODY IZ IN A HURRY TA BE DERE!
ME BOUGHT A {KETTLE|LAMP|CLOCK RADIO} AN' ME IZ ABSURDLY PROUD OF IT!
IT IZ A GENTLE SORT OF DAY. ME MEAN TA KEEP IT DAT WAY!
DA NEIGHBOUR'S DOG HAB DECIDED ME IZ A SHRUB. ME TAKE IT AS PRAISE!
ME COULD NO SLEEP, SO ME COUNTED DA SEEDS IN A POMEGRANATE!
HOW DO DEY FIT DA WHOLE ORCHESTRA INSIDE DA RADIO? ME HAB STOPPED ASKIN' ALOUD!
ME MEAN TA LEARN TA RIDE A BICYCLE {DIS SPRING|BEFORE WINTER|ONE DAY}. GENTLY!
DA TRAINS RUN ON TIME MORE OFTEN DEN DA GODS DO!
SOME DAYS DA FIELDS FEEL LIKE A BOOK ME READ ONCE. OTHERS, LIKE DIS MORNIN'!
DA POSTMAN KNOWS ME NAME NOW. ME FEEL ALMOST LOCAL!
ME WOULD TRADE A WEEK OF STUDY FOR ONE GOOD AFTERNOON OF RAIN!

OLD VERDEN WISDOM: NEVER ARGUE WIT A VINE. IT HAB MORE TIME DEN YOU!
ME COAT STILL HAB A SEAM FROM DA FIELDS. ME WILL NO LET ANYONE MEND IT!
DA ELEVATOR HUMMED A LIL' TUNE TODAY. ME HUMMED IT BACK!
ONE NO CAN HURRY A SEED, A SOUP OR A FRIENDSHIP!
ME MISREAD A TIMETABLE AN' SAW A WHOLE NEW DISTRICT. HAPPY ACCIDENT!
IF ME CLOSE ME EYES IN DA PARK, DA BIRDS ALMOST SOUND LIKE HOME!
ME HAB {THREE|FOUR|FAR TOO MANY} UNREAD BOOKS ON DA NIGHTSTAND AN' ME IZ BUYIN' ANOTHER!
A GOOD NEIGHBOUR IZ WORTH A WHOLE ORCHARD!
ME LEFT DA WINDOW OPEN FOR DA {RAIN|BREEZE|NIGHT AIR}. OLD HABIT!
DEY PUT DA WHOLE NIGHT SKY IN A PLANETARIUM. ME WENT TWICE!
HUMANS GREET DA CASHIER AN' FORGET DA TREE OUTSIDE. ME GREET BOTH!
TOMORROW ME WILL BE BRAVER 'BOUT DA ESCALATOR!
EVERY STREET HERE HAB A STORY. ME MEAN TA LEARN {A FEW|SOME|ALL} OF DEM!
BETTER A LIL' GARDEN KEPT WELL DEN A GREAT ONE FORGOTTEN!
DA KETTLE IZ SINGIN' SOMEWHERE. ME CAN ALMOST TASTE DA TEA!
A QUIET THOUGHT FOR DA ONES STILL BACK IN DA FIELDS. MAY DA SOIL HOLD DEM!

sleep: ME IZ WILTIN' LIKE A {FERN|SEEDLIN'|CUT FLOWER} LEFT IN DA SUN. BED,!

ME NEARLY DOZED OFF ON DA TRAM. DA ROCKIN' IZ TOO KIND!
ME THOUGHTS IZ SLOW AS SAP IN WINTER. ME NEED REST!
ME YAWNED IN DA MIDDLE OF A SENTENCE. MOST IMPROPER!
EVEN ME SPORES WOULD TELL ME TA LIE DOWN!
JUST {A FEW MORE STREETS|ONE MORE STOP|A LIL' FURTHER}, AN' DEN ME OWN BED!
A TIRED GARDENER WATERS DA WEEDS. ME MUST SLEEP!
ME WOULD TRADE EVERY GADGET IN DIS CITY FOR {EIGHT HOURS|A LONG NIGHT|A PROPER NAP}!
DA STREETLIGHTS BLUR INTO STARS. DAT MEANS IT IZ TIME!
ME STUDIED TOO LATE AGAIN. DA BOOK WILL FORGIVE ME; ME BACK WILL NO!
hunger: ME STOMACH IZ MAKIN' A NOISE NO POLITE VERDEN SHOULD MAKE!
ME COULD EAT {A WHOLE LOAF|A BOWL OF SOUP|THREE PEARS} AN' NO APOLOGISE!
ME HAB NO EATEN SINCE {MORNIN'|YESTERDAY|DA LAST STOP}. EVEN A SPROUT NEEDS FEEDIN'!
DAT BAKERY SMELL IZ A SPELL ALL ITS OWN!
PERHAPS DA VENDIN' MACHINE WILL BE GENEROUS TODAY!
IN DA FIELDS WE ATE WHAT WE GREW. HERE ME EAT WHATEVER IZ STILL OPEN!
SOMETINK WARM. {SOUP|STEW|PORRIDGE}. ANYTINK WIT A SPOON!
ME IZ HUNGRY ENOUGH TA TRY DA STATION SANDWICHES AGAIN!
A FULL BELLY MAKES FOR KINDER THOUGHTS. ME IZ NO KIND JUST NOW!
ME KEEP THINKIN' OF {ROASTED ROOTS|HONEY BREAD|GREEN BEANS} FROM HOME!
ME HANDS IZ SHAKIN' A LIL'. FOOD, AN' SOON!
ME COULD FORAGE DA PARK, BUT DA HUMANS WOULD STARE!
ONE EURO FOR A PASTRY. A REAL FAIR PRICE FOR HAPPINESS!
DA CHIP SHOP IZ CALLIN' ME. ME IZ TRYIN' NO TA LISTEN!
work: BACK TA WORK. DA {CRATES|STOCK LISTS|ORDERS} WILL NO SORT THEMSELVES!
ME SHIFT STARTS SOON. ME LIKE TA ARRIVE EARLY AN' GREET DA MACHINES!
HONEST WORK, HONEST EUROS. DA FIELDS WOULD APPROVE OF DA FIRST PART!
ME MUST NO BE LATE. ME EMPLOYER ALREADY THINKS ME IZ TOO SLOW!
SLOW AN' RIGHT IZ BETTER DEN FAST AN' TWICE. ME KEEP TELLIN' DEM!
DA TILL IZ A MARVELLOUS TINK. IT ADDS WITOUT EVER BEING TIRED!
WORK TODAY, {GARDEN|STUDY|REST} TOMORROW. DAT IZ DA BARGAIN!
ME WAZ A SCHOLAR OF ROOT MAGIC. NOW ME STACK {TINS|BOXES|SHELVES}. BOTH NEED CARE!
DA FOREMAN CALLS ME 'DA BLUE ONE'. ME HAB DECIDED IT IZ AFFECTION!
DERE IZ STILL SO MUCH TA DO BEFORE CLOSIN'!
HANDS BUSY, MIND QUIET. A GOOD WORKIN' DAY!
ME SHOULD CLOCK IN. EVEN DA CLOCKIN' MACHINE IZ CHARMIN'!
ME COLLEAGUES WORK FAST. ME WORK ONCE. WE FINISH TOGETHER!
RENT IZ DUE. WORK IT IZ.
ME HOPE DA {PHOTOCOPIER|FORKLIFT|COFFEE MACHINE} BEHAVES TODAY!
leisure: AN AFTERNOON WIT NUTTIN' TA DO. IN DA FIELDS DIS WAZ CALLED WISDOM!
ME WANT TA SIT IN DA PARK AN' WATCH {PIGEONS|CLOUDS|CHILDREN WIT KITES}!
DA ARCADE! ALL DOZE LIGHTS AN' LIL' SONGS. ME IZ HOPELESS AT IT AN' ME ADORE IT!
PERHAPS A FILM. ME STILL GASP AT DA BIG SCREEN!

TOO MUCH WORK AN' DA ROOTS DRY OUT. TIME TA PLAY!
A LONG WALK WIT NO DESTINATION. ME FAVOURITE KIND!
ME WOULD LOVE TA HEAR LIVE MUSIC TONIGHT. NO JUNEHEM,!
ME HAB A NEW CASSETTE AN' NOWHERE TA BE. BLISS!
SOMETINK FRIVOLOUS, JUST FOR AN HOUR!
A CROSSWORD. A REAL PUZZLE. ME IZ GETTIN' BETTER AT HUMAN WORDS!
DA PINBALL MACHINE HAB A DRAGON ON IT. ME SIMPLY MUST PLAY IT!
ME NEED TA LAUGH AT SOMETINK SILLY!
EVEN DA MOST PATIENT GARDENER NEEDS A HOLIDAY!
TELEVISION, TEA, A BLANKET. A REAL HUMAN EVENIN', AN' ME WANT IT!
crime: DAT {PURSE|WALLET|BAG} IZ HANGIN' SO CARELESSLY... NO. WE DO NO DO DAT!
HUNGER ARGUES WELL. ME MUST ARGUE BETTER!
A LIL' CHARM AN' DA LOCK WOULD OPEN. A REAL LIL' CHARM!
NOBODY WOULD NOTICE ONE {APPLE|LOAF|TIN} MISSIN'. ME WOULD!
ME ELDERS WOULD WEEP. BUT ME ELDERS IZ NO HUNGRY!
DA SHOPKEEPER IZ LOOKIN' DA OTHER WAY. STAY STILL, HANDS!
ME KNOW A SPELL FOR QUIET FOOTSTEPS. ME WISH ME DID NO!
JUST DIS ONCE. DAT IZ WHAT EVERYONE SAYS, ME SUPPOSE!
A DESPERATE SEASON MAKES DESPERATE GARDENERS!
DA TILL IZ OPEN. ME CONSCIENCE IZ NO!
IF ME IZ CAUGHT, DEY WILL SAY 'DAT GOBLIN'. AN' DEY WILL MEAN ALL OF US!
ME COULD PAY IT BACK LATER. ME COULD. MAYBE-MAYBE!
DA POLICE HERE IZ SLOW. DERE IZ A TEMPTATION, PLAIN AN' SIMPLE!
EASY PICKINGS, A NAGUKA WOULD SAY. ME IZ NO A NAGUKA!
ONE QUICK HAND AN' DA RENT IZ PAID. ONE QUICK HAND AN' ME IZ A THIEF!
hygiene: ME SMELL RATHER TOO MUCH LIKE COMPOST. EVEN FOR ME!
A HOT BATH. HUMANS INVENTED DA HOT BATH AN' FOR DAT ALONE ME FORGIVE DEM MUCH!

ME SKIN GOES DULL GREY WHEN ME NEGLECT IT. WASHIN', NOW!
DA LAUNDERETTE! ME HAB BIN LOOKIN' FORWARD TA DA LAUNDERETTE!
